snippet.title: The Last Zeppelin Main Theme (DJ Innopede) #soundtrack #gameplay #music #musicvideo
snippet.description:
The Last Zeppelin Main Theme is the title melody of the upcoming computer game "The Last Zeppelin" from Innopede.
The last Zeppelin is a casual, retro-inspired 2D shooter with an alt-history twist! Pilot the last Zeppelin in a parallel universe against a reptilian army. Master your Zero-Energy Impulse and blast through double-deckers and flying saucers. Simple controls, escalating difficulty, and pure arcade action.
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4601080/The_Last_Zeppelin/

The Last Zeppelin Main Theme
Copyright & Melody: Sven Vogelgesang
Music: Suno
